about_the_game:
Orphan from a distant world, you now unleash the power of the ultimate hero! Shrug off bullets, smash buildings with your bare hands, and fly through the sky as you battle a cabal of vicious villains! Unite a team of crime-fighters and save the city!

The Last Scion is a 190,000-word interactive novel by D. G. P. Rector. It's entirely text-based, without graphics or sound effects, and fueled by the vast, unstoppable power of your imagination.

You are the Scion, sole survivor of a distant planet called “Utopia”, come to Earth as a beacon of hope for its people. Take up the challenge of becoming a hero, and save your newfound home from a multitude of deadly threats! Will you protect the innocent, or punish the wicked? Embrace humanity, or remain aloof from mere mortals? You are the most powerful being on Earth, and the fate of the world is in your hands!

  • Create your own custom hero! Select your name, gender, costume, and secret identity!

  • Use your superhuman speed, strength, intellect, and the power of flight to defend the city!

  • Romance a relentless vigilante, a dashing hero, a daring reporter, a hard-bitten detective, or

  • a roguish villain!

  • Uphold the law, become a champion of the common people, or render justice as you see fit!
